Title: Public preview: Azure Communication Services APIs in US Government cloud

Body.Content:
In addition to the features and capabilities of voice, video calling, and messaging, you can now benefit from the following that are unique to the US Government cloud:

  • Personal data is logically segregated from customer content in the commercial Azure cloud.
  • Your content contained in Azure Communication Services resources is stored within the United States.
  • Access to your content is restricted to screened Microsoft personnel.
  • Azure Communication Services complies with certifications and accreditations that are required for US Public Sector customers.

Read the blog.
